name: arcana-web-dashboard
goal: Build the remaining dashboard pages for Arcana SaaS site (arcana.otnelhq.com) — session browser, billing, settings, proxy config. The site already has: marketing, auth (Supabase), basic workspace dashboard, status page, and PayPal credit purchasing. This completes the disabled nav items into working reports and settings UI. arcana CLI uses license keys only — no API key management needed.

allocation.item: Proxy API integration and new endpoints (sessions, purchases, profile)
Sessions page — search/filter agent session history from proxy
Billing page — transaction history, subscription status, invoices
Proxy Config page — balance, daily caps display
Polish, auth edge cases, deployment dry-run

budget.note: Fixed-price. All amounts in USD. Any unspent balance returned.

existingEcosystem.arcana_site: Cloudflare Pages site — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Pages Functions for SSR/API. Has: marketing homepage, auth (Supabase JWT), workspace dashboard (balance/credits/usage), status page, credit purchasing, sub creation. 6 nav items disabled (Sessions, Memory, API Keys, Proxy, Billing, Settings). API Keys item will remain disabled — not needed.
existingEcosystem.arcana_proxy: Cloudflare Worker at proxy.arcana.otnelhq.com — LLM proxy, PayPal payments, KV store for licenses/balances/usage. Auth via Supabase JWT or license keys. Has /v1/balance, /v1/usage, /v1/models endpoints. No session history API yet.
existingEcosystem.arcana_license_server: Cloudflare Worker at api.arcana.otnelhq.com — license validation/activation/machine binding. 4 tiers: free/pro/team/enterprise. KV + Durable Objects. Admin endpoints for key management.

leveraging: arcana-site existing Pages Functions pattern (credits.tsx, api/status.ts, etc.)
arcana-proxy existing /v1/balance, /v1/usage endpoints and JWT auth flow
Supabase auth session already working (JWT in Authorization header)
Existing workspace HTML/CSS structure and design system

allowed: add new endpoints (GET /v1/sessions, GET /v1/sessions/:id, GET /v1/purchases, GET /v1/profile, PUT /v1/profile)

pages.label: Dashboard Overview
pages.description: Add daily cost/token sparklines, model usage breakdown, recent sessions list with links to session detail. Keep existing balance/credits/usage cards.

pages.label: Session Browser
pages.description: Searchable, filterable agent session list from proxy KV. Expand rows to see tokens, cost, model used, duration. Replaces the disabled Sessions nav item.

pages.label: Proxy Config
pages.description: View credit balance, daily usage caps remaining, provider priority list. Read-only display. Replaces disabled Proxy nav item.

pages.label: Billing
pages.description: Transaction history (PayPal purchases), subscription status (tier, renewal date), invoices. Replaces disabled Billing nav item.

pages.label: Settings
pages.description: Account profile, email display, theme toggle (dark/light), notification preferences. Replaces disabled Settings nav item.

proxyEndpointsNeeded.description: Paginated session list for a user (needs new KV prefix and logging)

pagesFunctions.description: SSR proxy for /v1/sessions, adds auth headers

commands: cd L:/PROJECTS/arcana-site && npx wrangler pages deploy public --dry-run
manualReview: Open /workspace — dashboard shows cost/token trend data
Open /workspace/proxy — shows balance and daily caps

mitigations: All new proxy endpoints follow existing auth/rate-limit patterns
All new pages follow existing vanilla HTML/CSS/JS pattern
No changes to payment flow, auth chain, or provider proxy
KV data for sessions uses existing prefix conventions
Reuse existing workspace CSS design system

receipt.terms: 1000 USD fixed price for scope defined above. Any scope change requires new contract. Payment upon successful delivery and verification.
